**Setup:**
- 10 dice total
- Probability of rolling a 1 on one die: 1/6
- Probability of NOT rolling a 1 on one die: 5/6
- Want: exactly one 1 among all 10 dice

**Formula (Binomial Probability):**
P(X = 1) = C(10,1) × (1/6)¹ × (5/6)⁹

**Calculation:**
- C(10,1) = 10
- (1/6)¹ = 0.166667
- (5/6)⁹ = 0.193807
- P(X = 1) = 10 × 0.166667 × 0.193807 = 0.323486

**Answer: 0.323**
